_comment: Project now subscribes to the ai-team plugin (per workspace ADR-0015). The plugin ships the canonical hook scripts, subagent definitions, and slash commands. This file carries: (1) the marketplace subscription, (2) the permissions block (plugin spec cannot ship permissions), (3) the project-specific hooks that predate the platform (check-comments, check-secrets, protect-files) and cover gaps the platform hooks don't. When the workspace is published to GitHub, swap the directory source for {"source": "github", "repo": "jaetill/agentic-dev-environment"}.
